blurb: Kill teams of XV26 Stealth Battlesuits provide the T'au Empire with experts in innovative tactics considered unconventional - at best - by Fire caste academies. They use infiltration to identify and eliminate key targets, penetrate hostile regions to conduct aggressive reconnaissance, and launch ambushes from within the enemy's own midst.
lore: An XV26 team is the T'au admitting that some things cannot be solved by a firing line. They go in under a field that bends light around them, take the thing the cadre's guns cannot reach, and leave before the response arrives. Stealth cadre pilots are among the few T'au who routinely operate beyond the reach of an Ethereal's presence, and the caste notices.

source.notes: Operative stats, weapon profiles, actions, ploys and equipment transcribed from Wahapedia. Ranged weapons without a printed Range rule are given range 48 (effectively unlimited on a Kill Team board). Consult the official source for the current rules: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/downloads/kill-team/

operatives.name: XV26 Shas'Vre
operatives.lore: Veteran of enough covert deployments to be trusted alone, which for a T'au is an unusual amount of latitude. He uses it carefully.

operatives.name: XV26 Designator
operatives.lore: He paints the target for the cadre's heavy weapons and holds the mark while the shell is in the air.

abilities.name: FOCUSED MARKERLIGH
abilities.description: Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Once during this turning point, when a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do, improve the Hit stat of ranged weapons on that friendly operative's datacard by 1 until the end of that action. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

operatives.name: XV26 Infiltrator
operatives.lore: He goes deepest, alone, and the team's plan is built on what he reports back.

operatives.name: XV26 Liberator
operatives.lore: His task is the extraction — the prisoner, the device, the pilot who went down. The fighting is incidental to it.

weapons.name: EMP bomb
weapons.rulesText: Range 4", Blast 2", Devastating 1, Heavy (Reposition only), Lethal 4+, Limited 1, Saturate

operatives.name: XV26 Lodestar
operatives.lore: The team's navigational and sensor anchor. Without him a stealth team in an unmapped structure is simply lost.

operatives.name: XV26 Neutraliser
operatives.lore: Fusion blaster, at the range a fusion blaster was actually designed for. He is the answer to armour.

abilities.name: SYSTEM JAM
abilities.description: Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the end of that operative's next activation, subtract 1 from its APL stat. Whenever this operative has a Conceal order, you must spend 1 additional AP to perform this action. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

operatives.name: MV15 Gun Drone
operatives.lore: It holds the field's edge and fires on anything that has worked out where the team is.

abilities.name: PHOTON GRENADE LAUNCHER
abilities.description: Select one enemy operative visible to this operative and roll one D6: on a 3+, until the end of that operative's next activation, subtract 2" from its Move stat. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.Drone: This operative cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Photon Grenade Launcher, Reposition and Shoot.Whenever determining control of an objective marker, treat this operative's APL stat as 1 lower. Note this isn't a change to its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.This operative cannot use any weapons that aren't on its datacard.Whenever determining what's visible to this operative, the round disc at the top of the miniature is its head.This operative is ignored for your opponent's kill/elimination op (when it's incapacitated, and when determining your starting number of operatives). It's also ignored for victory conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives to 'escape', 'survive' or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if it escapes/survives/is incapacitated, determining how many operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).

operatives.name: MV75 Marker Drone
operatives.lore: A markerlight small enough to go where the suits go, and the reason the cadre's fire can follow them in.

factionRules.name: Kauyon
factionRules.description: Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an enemy operative, its ranged weapons have the Accurate X weapon rule. X is determined by that enemy operative's location. ENEMY OPERATIVE LOCATIONACCURATE XWithin 3" of your territoryAccurate 1Within your territoryAccurate 2Within 3" of your drop zoneAccurate 3

factionRules.name: Stealth Fields
factionRules.description: Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative has a Conceal order, it cannot be visible to enemy operatives more than 3" from it (this takes precedence over all other rules). Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative has a Conceal order, it can perform the Fall Back action for 1 less AP.

strategicPloys.name: PATIENT HUNTERS
strategicPloys.description: Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting against or fighting against an expended enemy operative, that friendly operative's weapons have the Balanced weapon rule and its ranged weapons have the Saturate weapon rule.

strategicPloys.name: PREPARE AMBUSH
strategicPloys.description: Place one of your Ambush markers wholly within your territory and more than 2" from enemy operatives. Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an enemy operative that's within 2" of that marker, you can use this rule. If you do, remove that marker and that friendly operative's ranged weapons have the Seek weapon rule until the end of the action. In the Ready step of the next Strategy phase, if that marker is still in the killzone, remove that marker.

hooks.notes: the Ambush marker is not placed; the Seek rule is granted once each turning point instead

strategicPloys.name: BONDS OF UNITY
strategicPloys.description: Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is activated (excluding DRONE), if it's visible to and within 6" of another friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding DRONE), you can ignore any changes to that first friendly operative's APL stat and select one of the following: Ignore any changes to that first friendly operative's Move stat from being injured until the end of that activation.Ignore any changes to the Hit stat of that first friendly operative's weapons from being injured until the end of that activation.

strategicPloys.name: HOLOWAVE COUNTERMEASURES
strategicPloys.description: Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative more than 6" from it, in the Roll Attack Dice step, the attacker must discard one of their unresolved normal successes (or one of their critical successes if there are none). This isn't cumulative with being obscured.

hooks.notes: printed as discarding a retained success; simulated as one fewer attack dice

firefightPloys.name: VECTORED RETRO-THRUSTERS
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative ends the Charge action within control range of a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding DRONE). Interrupt that action to use this rule. If you do, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Fall Back action, but it cannot move more than 3" during that action. This action cannot be prevented by your opponent's rules (taking precedence over all such rules). Then, that enemy operative can immediately perform a free Reposition action using any remaining move distance it had from that first Charge action, and can do so even if it's performed an action that prevents it from performing the Reposition action.

hooks.notes: printed as an interrupt when an enemy charges in; simulated as a free Fall Back during the battlesuit's own activation

firefightPloys.name: ENGAGE JET PACK
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding DRONE) is activated or counteracts. Until the end of that activation/counteraction, you can ignore the vertical distance it moves during one climb and one drop.

firefightPloys.name: GHOSTSHROUD
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy at the end of a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative's activation. If that operative has an Engage order, change it to Conceal. You cannot use this ploy for each friendly operative more than once per battle.

hooks.notes: printed as slipping back onto a Conceal order after acting; simulated as an extra defence dice for the activation

firefightPloys.name: SAVIOUR PROTOCOLS
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding DRONE) is selected as the valid target of a Shoot action. Select one friendly DRONE operative visible to and within 3" of that first friendly operative to become the valid target instead (even if it wouldn't normally be valid for this). That friendly DRONE operative is only in cover or obscured if the original target was. This ploy has no effect if the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent weapon rule.

equipment.name: XV26 MULTITRACKERS
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is performing the Shoot action and you select a burst cannon (sweeping), you can use this rule. If you do, select one of the following: Until the end of that action, that weapon has the Torrent 2" weapon rule.Until the end of that action, that weapon has the Torrent 3" weapon rule, but you cannot select more than one secondary target.

equipment.name: ADVANCED BLACKSUN FILTERS
equipment.description: Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an operative that's obscured, you don't have to discard one success as a result of that rule. All other effects of obscured apply as normal.

equipment.name: COUNTER-NETWORK JAMMERS
equipment.description: STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one objective marker or mission marker. Until the end of the turning point, whenever determining control of that marker, treat the total APL stat of enemy operatives that contest it as 1 lower if at least one of those enemy operatives is within 3" of friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operatives. Note this isn't a change to the APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.

equipment.name: HARDWIRED TARGET LOCKS
equipment.description: Whenever you would counteract, you can do so with one friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative that has a Conceal order and is more than 3" from enemy operatives, but before it counteracts, you must change its order to Engage and it cannot perform any actions other than Shoot during that counteraction.
